ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What is a food source for the platypus?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram is a food web with the platypus labeled near the top center. Several colored arrows point upward into the platypus from organisms below it. One of those organisms is labeled “backswimmer,” and its arrow points directly into the platypus. Reasoning: In this food web, arrows pointing into the platypus indicate food sources for the platypus. Since “backswimmer” has a direct arrow into the platypus, it is a food source for the platypus.
